candidate_windows.window_text:
Here we reparameterize the TED models for individual language pairs from Salesky et al. (2021) according to our findings in § 3.1, shifting encoder-decoder layer depth from 6-6 to 12-3 and feed-forward width from 1024 to 2048, while maintaining approximately the same number of parameters (55.3M vs. 56.9M). We see that this reparameterization is not optimal for individual language pairs with less data, or the individual de-en language pair with a similar amounts of data to TED-7.
